`db.py` and `LICENSE` are vendored from the verified `wechat-bot-lab/_work/background-read/source/db.py` snapshot. Keep the upstream `LICENSE` with the copied source.

The current adapter loads `db.py` through `wechat_db.source._load_vendored_db`; `EncryptedSource` wraps it in `ScopedWeChatDB` and uses only its database decryption/query helpers. The wrapper pins one configured account directory, explicit key-cache file and work directory, and rejects process-memory key extraction, account discovery/switching, cross-account fallback, key-cache discovery and key-cache writes. Decrypted database copies are kept in the configured work directory. This vendored code is only for reading databases; the optional text sender is implemented separately in `wechat_db.legacy_sender` and `wechat_db.native_send`.
